title: Carburettor
object: Fixed-jet float-bowl carburettor, 26 mm bore, in axial section
idea: Bernoulli's principle: one flow metering another
summary: Air speeding through the venturi throat loses ½ρv² of pressure, and because the float bowl is vented that depression lifts petrol through the main jet, so fuel follows air in proportion. Below the threshold the pilot circuit takes over through the idle and progression ports; the float drops as the jets draw, and its needle opens to refill the bowl.
usedFor: Engine and motorcycle courses: venturi depression, jetting, idle and progression circuits
Workshop and product documentation for small-engine carburettors
Explaining proportional control, where one flow meters another
